summary.text: Cecilia Castellano is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 80 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Don McLaughlin.
She also ran for the seat in 2024, when she lost the general election to McLaughlin.

paragraphs.text: Castellano first appeared on the District 80 ballot in 2024, when she finished first in a five-candidate Democratic primary on March 5, 2024, and then defeated Rosie Cuellar in the May 28, 2024 primary runoff.
McLaughlin defeated her in the November 5, 2024 general election, 59.5 percent to 40.5 percent.
Castellano won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, defeating Julie Hilberg with 76.7 percent of the vote.
